# laminar_llm_profile (Data Source)

Reads an existing LLM profile of the provider's workspace by `id` or exact `name`. Credentials are never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "laminar_llm_profile" "openai" {
  name = "openai"
}

output "openai_models" {
  value = data.laminar_llm_profile.openai.models
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) LLM profile UUID. Exactly one of `id` and `name` is required.
- `name` (String) Exact profile name. Names are unique within a workspace.

### Read-Only

- `api_version` (String) Azure: API version.
- `auth_type` (String) Authentication method.
- `aws_access_key_id` (String) Bedrock `aws_keys` auth: AWS access key id.
- `base_url` (String) Azure or custom gateway: endpoint URL.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `header_names` (List of String) Custom gateway: names of the extra headers.
- `llm_provider` (String) LLM provider.
- `models` (Set of String) Model names this profile may use.
- `region` (String) Bedrock: AWS region.
- `resource_id` (String) Azure: resource name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `workspace_id` (String) UUID of the workspace that owns the profile.
